> Since switching to Unthread, the team can focus on being proactive rather than reactive, and employees get the help they need faster”
> - Dennis Ong, IT Manager, Sisense


## Why an AI-Native Helpdesk


Sisense is an AI company that provides world-class embedded analytics and insights for their customers. When AI intelligence is at the heart of your company like Sisense, it’s important that your ITSM and your employee experience matches that.


## Meeting Employees Where They Are


When your employees already live in one tool every day to collaborate, there are switching costs in trying to bring them to a new tool for one-off tasks. Sisense’s team understood this and launched a full-fledged employee support experience natively in Slack. This means adding the Unthread bot to channels to resolve questions instantly as well as DMs with the Unthread bot to get their request routed to the right team.


What started with Slack now extends to AI clients through the Unthread MCP, allowing users to access support directly from their favorite approved AI tools.


## Transitioning From Legacy ITSM Tools


Transitioning ITSMs can be an arduous process involving a lot of factors like migrating data, recreating configurations, training team members. A key part of the transition was the seamless sync of data and configuration into Unthread so the team could get up and running on day one.


## The Result: 99% CSAT And Automatic Resolution


It’s no surprise that when you let employees file tickets from the tools they already use every day, they’re more likely to be satisfied with the services provided. On top of that, the IT team has access to automation tools and agentic AI to resolve issues in a matter of seconds. The result has been a **99% CSAT score across hundreds of survey responses** from their team members.


## First IT, Then The World


Dennis led the charge of the IT team first testing Unthread in a POC before bringing on other key teams like Procurement, Finance and other business teams. With everyone’s ticketing unified into a single tool, it’s easier to collaborate and share context, especially with details being shared across Slack with the right team members.
